# Roads of Chiang Mai

> The square of 1296, four rings around it, 6,934 km of road between, and what each one did to the city. Counted from the map, dated from the record.

Canonical: https://motdang.net/roads/ · Alternate: https://nanobotco.github.io/chiang-mai-roads/ · Thai: https://motdang.net/roads/th/
Records: 153 across 16 types, CC BY 4.0. API: https://motdang.net/roads/api/
Network: 52,389 OpenStreetMap ways, 8,054.7 km in the city box, measured by zone at https://motdang.net/roads/old-city/ and https://motdang.net/roads/api/measures.json
Traffic: 81 highway counting stations at https://motdang.net/roads/traffic/ and https://motdang.net/roads/api/aadt.json

## Elsewhere from the same publisher

Made by Hongdam (https://hongdam.net/), a bilingual web studio in Chiang Rai.
